item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 21/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The dry northeast monsoon will persist over the coast of southern China in the next few days. It will be generally fine over the region. Temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas. Under the influence of the replenishment of the monsoon, the weather will become cold over Guangdong in the latter part of next week.

Date/Month: 22/12 (Thursday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4.
Weather: Fine. Very dry during the day. Rather cool in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 13 - 19 C
R.H. range: 35 - 60 per Cent
PSR: Low
